sections.heading: C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Turning
sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Turning

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Right turns start furthest right and end curb-side, while left turns start furthest left and end leftmost [A01].
Why it matters: group turn-craft; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F08, sec08-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
U-turns need clear signs, town intersections, and no highway; each condition bans them alone [A01].
Why it matters: group turn-craft; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A01
U-turns add a full stop and yield before entering the far lane, while left turns yield without stopping [A01].
Why it matters: group turn-craft; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F03, sec08-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A01
Signals open three to four seconds ahead of the move and must be canceled after it [A01].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F04, sec08-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A01
Left arm straight means left, left arm up means right, and left arm down means slow or stop [A01].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A01
Over-correction slides the rear out from sharp steering, and recovery means easing speed, aiming eyes, and steering back slowly [A01].
Why it matters: group turn-craft; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A02
Two seconds serve under thirty-five, three serve thirty-five to forty-five, four serve forty-six to seventy, and none serve above seventy [A02].
Why it matters: group following-gaps; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A02
Fixed-object timing detects a short gap, while large vehicles, weather, exits, small bikes, and tailgaters demand a longer one [A02].
Why it matters: group following-gaps; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F12, sec08-F14 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A02
Hands answer in about a half second and feet in about three-quarters, before tiredness, medication, or distraction add more [A02].
Why it matters: group following-gaps; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F13 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A02
The tailgated driver moves over or flashes brakes to slow, while the considerate driver holds steady speed with early brake taps [A02].
Why it matters: group following-gaps; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F15 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A02
Eyes run twenty to thirty seconds ahead, mirrors check about every ten seconds, and intersections get left-right-left [A02].
Why it matters: group searching; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F16, sec08-F18 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]
